StructurePressure.claim: The structure-first mode is frequent on these four paths. Its causal contribution to score is unmeasured.

SiegeRetaliation.claim: Tower assault can retarget an in-range attacker; later home/recovery commands can override it. Guard counts are not landed hits or causal effectiveness.

NearestDefender.claim: A geometrically nearest visible hero handles exposed-god defense; no communication or identity recognition.

AttackRecovery.claim: A final walkTo(selfX,selfY) after a new landed basic interrupts recovery and cancels prior attack intent; next invocation restores an attack. Our deployed controller already uses this principle.

BlindTransferRisk.claim: Draft role bonus and branch names are not score evidence. Source still uses older potion affordability constants; two neural inputs and mode18 are unused. No explicit score/XP-time optimizer exists.

belief.uncertainty: Four retrospective Warlock games; no newly validated other-class online predictor, no learned-weight causal attribution, no semantic proxy validation.

goal.FightReachableThreats: Respond to nearby attackers while preserving basic damage.
goal.ProtectExposedGod: Allocate home defense based on geometry and structure state.
goal.MaintainResources: Use gear/healing/mana and return from death.
goal.ScoreTransfer: Our experiment objective is individual XP-minus-time, which must be tested independently.
